description: Returns the bills whose title holds a text, or that the Parliament registered in a period, or that carry a registration number (372/2-XIმპ), newest first. Each bill has its identifier, title, type, registration number and date, initiator, author, and newest review stage. Read the stages and votes with parliament_get_bill. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

from.description: The first date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: The count of bills of a page, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

page.description: The page, from 1. The default is 1.

query.description: A text of the title, in Georgian, 1 to 128 characters, for example ბიუჯეტ.

to.description: The last date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: parliament_search_bills

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the data, RFC 3339.

bills.description: The bills of the page, newest first.

author.description: The body that drafted the bill.

initiator.description: The body that submitted the bill.

newest_reading.description: The reading code of the newest stage, when it is a reading.

newest_stage.description: The name of the newest review stage.

registration_number.description: The registration number of the package.

url.description: The page of the bill at the Parliament.

notice.description: Set when a text with no Georgian letter found nothing.

page.description: The page of this answer, from 1.

source.description: The source of the data: Parliament of Georgia.

stale.description: True when the Parliament did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

total.description: The count of all the matches at the source.

title: Search the bills of the Parliament of Georgia
